correctness.rationale: Both orientations on a pair forbid the all-positive label; on a cycle choose a cyclic traversal with at least one positive edge, giving inconsistent cyclic weak inequalities with one strict inequality. On a forest the imposed orientations are acyclic and even distinct ranks suffice, proving precisely the stated support criterion and n−1, including the empty domain at n=1. A depth-d tree needs 2^d distinct concepts. The four-label positive root branch has (75−13)/2=31 concepts by collapsing tied labels and swapping the two labels on strict orders, so depth six fails. An independent scan of consecutive-surjective rank tuples and exact depth feasibility returned the four dimensions 0,1,3,5 with 1,3,13,75 distinct concepts; it separately checked all 8 and 32 leaf paths against the supplied certificate. Concatenation allows independently chosen within-block weak orders and fixes all between-block comparisons, proving 5s and the gap s+1 without any extrapolation from the computation.
residual_risks: Exact adaptive ranks were checked only at n≤4; no larger exact formula is asserted.

originality.rationale: Pass for the model-specific tie-sensitive adaptive profile and its consequences, not for the general idea of block amplification or for the static combinatorics by itself. Forest shattering is the same as for strict permutations; the adaptive ranks differ when opposite comparisons can both receive zero. The closest larger and smaller order classes do not imply the exact profile or when the first weak-order gap occurs. Bounded evidence does not establish historical priority.
residual_risks: Focused primary searches and the compared records do not rule out nonindexed exact comparison-tree evaluations or alternate terminology.

value.rationale: The first gap is an exact boundary for a natural binary comparison model where ties are unobserved on a single negative answer. The three- and four-item thresholds distinguish it from strict permutation comparison and the four-item threshold also distinguishes it from unconstrained strict-poset comparison. The finite result supplies a concrete product witness; the broad existence of adaptive/static gaps is not itself the scientific gain.
residual_risks: The displayed amplification is a lower bound, not an optimum or an asymptotic rank estimate.
